reviewSamples.author: Photo of Linsayd Avila
reviewSamples.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I had the pan con bistec with garbanzos, and it was delicious! The owners are all amazing and welcomed me like family. Their sweets are wonderful, too. I had such a great experience at Chandler Place in Coral Gables and will definitely be back!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Chris Janiewicz
reviewSamples.text: I discovered this place travelling for work and love it. It’s run by a husband and wife who are so sweet and friendly. The food is simple but delicious. They’ve been in business for 14 years so make sure you stop by to keep this great family run business going.
